fact: Djibouti adopted a ten-year ICT roadmap in 2014, the Schéma Stratégique Intégré 2014-2024 (SSI), which expires in 2024; a mid-term SSI review is under way and a final review is planned to assess achievement of its objectives.
title: Djibouti Digital Foundations Project - Project Appraisal Document (Document d'évaluation de projet)
